## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm.cmd run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm.cmd test`
- [ ] `npm.cmd run validate`
- [ ] `npm.cmd run build`
- [ ] Hardware testing, when applicable

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Runtime behavior remains local-only.
- [ ] No secrets, private addresses, generated builds, or third-party SDK
      archives are included.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
